title: Anima × OpenAI healthtech hackathon
summary: The programme and sponsor announcements for the September 2026 hackathon at OpenAI’s London HQ, themed “Save more lives than a superhero”.
body_markdown:
On 21 August, Anima and OpenAI announced a healthcare hackathon scheduled for 12 September 2026 at OpenAI’s London HQ. The event date has now passed; this article records the programme and sponsor announcements.


## The challenge


The theme was “Save more lives than a superhero”. The programme set a 12-hour challenge for around 100 builders to create something that would advance the NHS’s 10-Year Health Plan. It welcomed software builders, doctors who code, technical founders and students.


Participants were to receive a simulated NHS neighbourhood of 50,000 people and a Codex allowance. Anima also announced plans to open-source its agent development kit at the event, with participants becoming its first external users.


## Talks and prizes


The programme included talks from Anima and OpenAI on applied AI and building agents, followed by judging of the submissions. The announced prize pool was at least £25,000 across cash, gadgets and merchandise.


A 10 September update named Eight Sleep, Hilo by Aktiia and Pocket as hardware sponsors. Their contributions included the Pod sleep system, the Hilo Band blood-pressure monitor and the Pocket AI note-taker.


The campaign also appeared at King’s Cross station, where we shared the invitation to join the hackathon.


[Visit the hackathon website](https://animahacks.com/)
